messages:
leah_cs: loop: NovaHealth (pilot) raised PHI/data-retention concerns. they said they can't continue to step 2 until we confirm data handling + deletion within 30 days. potential to pause pilot -> renewal risk. cc @ryan_security @nina_product @emma_legal

nova-eng: confirming — our legal team flagged we may not send sample patient data to hosted endpoints; need clarity on where telemetry lands and who can access it.

ryan_security: acknowledged. we can offer a private preview (VPC) or anonymization via client-side tokenization. quick Q: do they require HSM/KMS integration or just no-PHI at rest?

nova-eng: prefer no PHI at rest. KMS optional. main ask: guarantee deletion + no human access.

emma_legal: we have a DPA addendum template for PHI-sensitive pilots. i'll share redlined language. also need SOC2 cert copy — linking internal pack: https://redwood.app/sec/pack/phi-pilot (internal)

nina_product: product note: we can enable data retention policy per-tenant (30/90/365 days) and disable human review for that tenant. can enable a 'no-human-access' flag but needs minor infra flip. ETA 3 days if approved.

oliver_onboarding: proposing 45m call tomorrow 09:00 PT to present options and sign DPA addendum. i'll own runbook for conversion to private preview if chosen.

leah_cs: schedule pls. if they pause pilot that's a mid-term churn risk. want to surface RISK_HIGH in CRM if not resolved within 72h.

status-bot: Meeting scheduled: NovaHealth PHI sync 2026-03-26T16:00:00Z (45m). Invited: leah_cs, ryan_security, emma_legal, nina_product, oliver_onboarding, nova-eng.

ryan_security: quick plan: 1) DPA redline (emma) 2) confirm SOC2 + KMS options (me) 3) enable retention toggle & no-human flag (nina) 4) conversion runbook + timeline (oliver) 5) CRM risk flag + follow-up (leah)

leah_cs: agreed. adding 'PHI-pilot' tag to the account and setting RenewalAtRisk = true for now. will escalate to AM if not cleared by EOW.

nova-eng: appreciate the quick response. will review DPA and confirm whether they want private preview or tokenization workflow.

nina_product: prepping a short doc + sample config for 'no-human-access' that we can demo. posting link after call.

emma_legal: sharing DPA snippet here for internal review:
``
"Data Deletion": "Redwood will delete all customer supplied data tagged as PHI within 30 days of request and will not allow human access to unresolved data unless explicitly authorized in writing."
```

leah_cs: thanks. action owners noted. flagging for follow-up in 72h. :triage: 

oliver_onboarding: i'll pre-build an onboarding checklist for private preview conversion (network setup, KMS config, test dataset, acceptance criteria). will paste checklist here before the call.

leah_cs: thanks team. closing the thread for now but keeping the CRM flag active. will reopen if any blocker emerges. :handshake:
